annotations.title: High-Entropy Boolean & Semantic Search Query Expander

description: Generates targeted Boolean queries, semantic synonym variations, and sub-question expansions from an ambiguous prompt. Use when overcoming query vocabulary mismatches and expanding search recall across academic, code, or patent databases; for scoping queries to domain categories, use filter_domain_intelligence instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'base_query' ('expansion_strategy' defaults to 'boolean_operators'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

base_query.description: Initial search prompt or ambiguous question requiring semantic query expansion.

expansion_strategy.description: Query expansion method: Boolean operators, semantic synonyms, or cross-domain questions.

target_count.description: Target count of query variations to synthesize.

name: expand_search_queries

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for expand_search_queries.

expanded_queries.description: Array of synthesized search strings optimized for search engine indexing.

intent_classification.description: Identified query intent (e.g., informational, transactional, technical_navigational).

original_query.description: Original user input query before expansion.
